title: Watch: Life and career of iconic actor Sir Patrick Stewart
description: Over seven decades, Sir Patrick received multiple Emmys and Golden Globes, a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame and a knighthood from Queen Elizabeth II.

title: 'Continue your journey': Key moments of leaked Spain train crash audio
description: Recordings between a control centre and the train drivers appear to show one train was given clearance to move even though another train had stalled on the track.

title: Google value plunges by $500bn as AI fears rattle Wall Street
description: Google spooked investors so badly that its stock hit a six-month low, after it revealed its AI search summaries were affecting ad revenue.

title: Crypto worth billions frozen after suspected Binance hack
description: The firm said transactions are suspended while it conducts security checks and will "cover all losses".

title: Bombshell confession in The Traitors as faithfuls finally turn the screw
description: Could the faithfuls finally come good in Thursday's penultimate episode?

title: What are the government's options for reducing welfare spending?
description: BBC Verify examines how much the welfare system costs and the options the government could use to reduce it.

title: Hyrox athlete who soiled herself in race tells BBC she put others at risk but says backlash was traumatic
description: In her first interview since the incident, Joanna Wietrzyk told the BBC she takes responsibility for it but did not deserve such a severe backlash.

title: Israeli opposition accuses Netanyahu of trying to 'delegitimise' election
description: The PM's Likud party has alleged foreign interference and said Arab-led parties "stole" the election after his coalition lost its majority.

title: Student-backed election winners demand sweeping resignations in Serbia
description: Days after ousting Aleksandar Vučić's party from power, Student List MPs call for top figures to stand down.
